title: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly.
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly.

Hidden among the desert stones…
I watch Hagar sitting alone beneath a fragile desert shrub.
The wilderness stretches endlessly around her.

She was cast out.
Forgotten.
Overlooked.
But then she whispers something remarkable…
“You are the God who sees me.”
In that moment, the silence of the desert feels different.
Because even when the world overlooks someone…
And standing there quietly as a witness, it makes me wonder…
How many unseen prayers has God already heard?
